name: Midnight Pulse DJ
description: A night-mode, pulsing-gradient theme for DJs and entertainment hire: a jog-wheel hero that beats in time, event packages printed as laminated backstage passes, a rack of add-on sound and lighting gear with a build-your-rig estimate, a mix archive of records filterable by genre and BPM, booking-line hours with a lines-open status and a Jamstacks contact component for date and quote enquiries.
